records.text: Aubrey Laitsch was a former Turning Point USA public relations manager, was part of a recent mass termination group, and was released while working directly for Andrew Kolvet's ATK company.
records.speaker: Aubrey Laitsch

appearances.snippet: My name is Aubrey Laitsch and I am the former public relations manager for Turning Point USA and I was a part of the recent kind of mass termination group at Turning Point and was let go about three weeks ago and at the time of my release I was working for the ATK company which is spokesman Andrew Kolvet's private business that contracts out with ... with the Turning Point kind of ecosystem. ... I was working directly for him.

verification.notes: Transcript context at 1476-1515s is Laitsch's direct account. TPUSA's own press kit and contemporaneous Fox/AP reporting corroborate that Aubrey Laitsch was a TPUSA public-relations representative, and later reporting confirms she was fired amid a broader group of terminations. Her precise contractor relationship with Andrew Kolvet's ATK company is supported only by her account, so the compound statement is mixed.

And the Uber driver allegedly said Aubrey (Aubrey Laitsch), Aubrey (Aubrey Laitsch) who? ... Aubrey Laitsch. ... And the story was presented to me as one of the reasons for my termination.

verification.notes: Transcript context at 1593-1650s is Aubrey Laitsch's detailed first-person description of her termination meeting. Her original public video and independent reporting consistently record that leadership presented the Uber driver's secondhand story as one reason for firing her; TPUSA has not publicly supplied records rebutting that account.

records.text: Turning Point USA also fired Aubrey Laitsch's fiancé, wiping out the household's entire income in one day without giving him an explanation.

appearances.snippet: And by the way, she didn't mention this in the video, but that young woman, they also then fired her fiance. ... So their entire income in one house was wiped out in one day. ... No explanation given to him.

verification.notes: Transcript context at 2647-2663s provides this claim only through Owens; Laitsch did not mention it in the played excerpt. Current searches found no identified fiancé, termination notice, employer statement, or independent report verifying same-day dismissal, total household-income loss, or absence of an explanation.

appearances.snippet: And Justin (Justin Streiff) jumps in on the text and he says that it's up to Andrew (Andrew Kolvet) and Andrew (Andrew Kolvet) doesn't answer. records.text: Laura Loomer alleged Candace Owens, Nick Fuentes, David Axelrod, and Aubrey Laitsch converged in Rome for a secret anti-Trump summit and suggested it was funded by foreign money connected to Qatar
records.speaker: Laura Loomer

appearances.snippet: For a secret anti-Trump summit just days after Barack Hussein Obama's top advisor, David Axelrod, met with the Pope, Candace Owens, Nick Fuentes, and the alleged fire Turning Point USA leaker, Aubrey Laitsch, all suddenly appeared in Rome. ... A reliable source informed me that Aubrey (Aubrey Laitsch) approached several conservatives last year in an effort to recruit them to attend a paid propaganda trip to Qatar. ... I have suspicion it is all being funded by foreign dark money.

verification.notes: The source episode reads Loomers post in full, including the alleged Rome convergence of Owens, Fuentes, Axelrod, and Laitsch and her suspicion of Qatar-linked foreign funding. This verifies that Loomer made the accusation; searches found no evidence establishing a secret summit or foreign funding.
